title: Regularity of fractional Schrödinger equations and sub-Laplacian multipliers on the Heisenberg group
summary: We define functions of the sub-Laplacian $Δ$ on the Heisenberg group $\mathbb H^d$ as Fourier multipliers. In this setting, we show that the solution $u$ of the free fractional Schrödinger equation $i\partial_tu + (-Δ)^νu = 0, u|_{t=0} = u_0$, for any $ν> 0$, satisfies the Hardy space estimate that $$ \|u(t,\cdot)\|_{H^p(\mathbb H^d)} \leq C_p (1 + t)^{Q|1/p-1/2|}\|(1-Δ)^{νQ|1/p-1/2|}u_0\|_{H^p(\mathbb H^d)}, $$ with $Q = 2d + 2$, for all $p \in (0,\infty)$, and the corresponding estimate with $p = \infty$ in $\mathrm{BMO}(\mathbb H^d)$.
